title: Page 3
content_zh:
“你妈呢？每个月给她的钱还不够医一个小孩子，钱都花到哪里去了？”严厉又冷漠的长者无视她快要哭出来的语调，厉声责备。

文景瑞站在转角，安抚时光不让它出声，仗着自己的所在位置不会被轻易发现之便，静静看着眼前的一幕。

只见一名被随扈围绕着，神情倨傲的老人用着排拒的眼神瞅着十步之外，表情局促、穿着平价服饰的憔悴女人。

那女人不知是畏惧老人的气势，还是被他的问话吓得说不出话来，好半晌才嗫嚅地道：“妈、妈妈在欧洲，联络不到她，我是真的没办法了才来找外公……外公，希恩她……”

“把你妈找出来解决这件事。”温祖雄看也不看卑微小心的外孙女一眼，提脚走人。

“外公、外公，请听我说，希恩她……”见外公要走，女人慌了、乱了，急急忙忙要追上前说明情况。

可温祖雄头也不回的离开，还为了阻止她的纠缠让随扈挡下她，直到他上了车，离开了俱乐部，随扈才放开她，迳自离开。

女人眼睁睁看着温祖雄离去，彷佛失去了所有的希望，顿时跌坐在地，大大的眼睛盛满了绝望，而后痛哭出声。

“外公，希恩会死的……”她干裂的嘴唇喃喃吐出话语，“我所有的存款都拿去付医药费还是不够，手术也要好多钱，除了手术费，接下来还有看护以及其他的费用，前前后后要好多钱……”

女人无视自己正坐在脏乱的地上，满地的草和泥土弄脏了她的衣物，她只是绝望地掩面哭泣。“救救希恩，她不能死啊……只要谁能救希恩，要我怎样都可以，拜托救救她……”

文景瑞不清楚她口中的希恩是什么人，可这个女人就算化成灰他也认得，她叫温希琳，与此同时，一段尘封在深处的记忆浮现，他眼神灼灼地看着哭泣不已的她，嘴角噙着笑。

人品好、身体健康的女性，眼前就有一个，而方才发生的事情让文景瑞知道，温希琳急需要一笔钱，这样岂不是刚刚好吗？

牵着安静乖巧的时光，他信步走到温希琳面前，开口说道：“你刚才说，只要谁能救你口中的人，要你怎样都可以？”

一道嗓音传入耳中，温希琳讶异地抬头，望向那名说话的男人。

他个子高高的，一身马术装扮，还牵着一匹黑亮的马，因为他背对着夕阳，让哭得泪眼婆娑的她一时看不清面貌。

他是谁？为什么跟她说话？他有什么目的？

温希琳揉了揉眼，这才看清男人的样貌。他的轮廓极深，浓黑的剑眉可以看出他强烈的性格，炯亮的双眸里没有太多情绪，他五官深邃、鼻梁高挺，薄薄的唇噙着浅笑，笑意却未达眼底。

这个男人散发出危险的气息，可他的五官却让温希琳感觉似曾相识。

“一千万够不够帮你？”文景瑞把玩着手中的马鞭，慢条斯理地问。

“太多了……”温希琳直觉回答，希恩的病不需要花到一千万。

文景瑞闻言笑了出来，对眼前的女人越加满意。“温希琳，你真是一点也没变。”还是那么的单纯，那么的蠢。

方才男人对她说话时，她还呆呆的不明所以，可现在这人精准喊出她的全名，瞬间让她回过神。

“你是谁？”温希琳想不起来在哪里见过这个男人，“无缘无故的，为什么愿意帮我？”而且还开口就是一千万。

文景瑞松开时光的缰绳，伸手探向温希琳，拉起跌坐在地上的她，让她在他眼前站好。

“我叫文景瑞。”说完，文景瑞满意地看着她充满眼泪的双眸倏地睁大，从疑惑转为惊愕。

很好，她绝对是想起他了。

“我太失望了，你竟然忘记我，我可是一眼就认出你呢。”他笑容和煦，表情也是温和无比。“琳琳，我们来谈桩交易吧，我给你一千万，让你去救人，而你跟我结婚，帮我生个小孩。”

这几句话像核弹般在温希琳脑中爆炸，她小嘴微张，呆呆的看着眼前英俊帅气的男人。

“景瑞哥哥……”

“很高兴你记得我，如何，你的决定？”文景瑞噙着笑，一点也不觉得她会拒绝自己的要求，即使那有多么无理。

他怎会这么有把握这女人不会拒绝呢？呵，因为他很了解她，毕竟温希琳的母亲是文渊华三段婚姻中的第二任妻子——他跟眼前这个女人曾经是一家人。

第2章(1)

从文景瑞有记忆起，母亲便告诉他，他是父母的爱情结晶。

“可惜你爷爷不喜欢我。”不被心爱男人的父亲接受，母亲憔悴的脸庞笑得苦涩。“我比你爸大五岁，我们恋爱的时候他才十八，还是个学生，而我无父无母，只是一个连高中都没念完的孤儿，为了你爸爸好，我答应你爷爷离开他，你爸爸不知道我离开的时候有了你。景瑞，如果你爸爸知道你的存在，他一定会很开心，一定会很疼你。”

这世界上文景瑞最爱的女人就是母亲，也只有母亲说的话他深信不疑，母亲对他的期盼他会拚了命去完成，母亲要他做的事他也一定会去做。

当他母亲得知癌细胞已经扩散到全身，时日不多后，便要他在自己死后回文家认祖归宗，跟爸爸姓文，受好的教育。

文景瑞照着母亲的遗愿一一执行，母亲过世没多久，他在社工的帮助下辗转联络到生父，并与之碰面，当时的情况却跟母亲所深信的完全不同。

“你真是我儿子 ”文渊华惊呼，一脸不敢置信。

这质疑文景瑞出身的问句，立刻摧毁了母亲长年以来告诉他的—— 他们很相爱，若不是因为父亲家里反对，他们会是非常幸福的一家人。

“你妈叫什么名字？啊……啊啊，是，我想起来了，她说你是我儿子？真的假的？”文渊华搔搔头。

生父毫不掩饰的错愕和隐隐的排拒并没有逃过文景瑞的眼。

“你说的是什么话啊！”跟着文渊华一同出现的是个年轻美丽，看起来绝对没有三十岁的年轻女人，她瞪了他一眼，不满的说。

跟长时间工作而身形干瘦、头发枯黄的母亲不同，眼前的女人皮肤白皙光滑，眼角没有半分皱纹，头发乌黑亮丽，身上的衣物是新的、干净的，没有半点洗旧或者是脱线的痕迹。

反观自己，身上穿的是一件洗到褪色，还有几个小破洞的旧Ｔ恤，指甲也不若父亲以及那名美女的干净，上头残留着他暑假时在工厂打工，根本洗不掉的黑油垢，只要一眼，他就明白自己和他们是不同世界的人。

“他长得跟爸一模一样，百分之百是你们文家的小孩，文渊华，你连自己爸爸年轻时候的脸都认不出来呀？他绝对是你儿子！”女人一边说着，一边狂捏文渊华腰间的肉。“你这个花心大萝卜，自己的小孩都不认得！”

“别捏别捏，我有说不认吗？啧，你怎么一点也不吃醋？”文渊华立刻讨饶，见老婆没有任何不悦的反应，立刻不爽了。

“吃什么醋呀？你的小孩就是我的小孩。”女人瞪他一眼，模样娇俏又美丽。

“雅雅，你果然是最棒的女人。”文渊华感动地搂紧她。

“不然你娶我干么？”女人回抱住他，两人卿卿我我、大力放闪，完全忽视文景瑞的存在。

娶？父亲结婚了

因为母亲骤逝，他的心情本就低落，谁知见了父亲，却完完全全没有母亲所说的“爸爸会很高兴有他”的情况出现。
content_en:
"Where is your mother? The money given to her every month is not enough to treat a child, so where has the money been spent?" The stern and indifferent elder scolded her, ignoring her tone of voice that was about to cry.

Wen Jingrui stood at the corner, soothing Shi Shi so that he wouldn't make a sound. Relying on the fact that his position would not be easily discovered, he quietly watched the scene in front of him.

I saw an arrogant old man surrounded by his entourage, looking with repulsive eyes at the haggard woman with a cramped expression and cheap clothes ten steps away.

The woman didn't know whether she was afraid of the old man's aura or was frightened by his questions and was speechless. After a long while, she muttered: "Mom, mom is in Europe and I can't contact her. I really had no choice so I came to see grandpa...Grandpa, Sheen, she..."

"Find your mother and resolve this matter." Wen Zuxiong walked away without even looking at his humble and cautious granddaughter.

"Grandpa, grandpa, please listen to me, Sheen, she..." Seeing that her grandfather was about to leave, the woman panicked and confused, and hurriedly caught up to explain the situation.

But Wen Zuxiong left without looking back, and in order to stop her entanglement, he asked the guard to block her. It wasn't until he got in the car and left the club that the guard let her go and left.

The woman watched Wen Zuxiong leave, as if she had lost all hope, and immediately fell to the ground, her big eyes filled with despair, and then she cried bitterly.

"Grandpa, Sheen is going to die..." She murmured words through her chapped lips, "It's not enough to use all my savings to pay for medical expenses. The surgery also costs a lot of money. In addition to the surgery fee, there are also nursing care and other expenses. It costs a lot of money..."

The woman ignored that she was sitting on the dirty ground, and the grass and mud on the ground soiled her clothes. She just covered her face and cried in despair."Save Xian, she can't die... As long as someone can save Xian, I will do anything. Please save her..."

Wen Jingrui didn't know who Xien she was talking about, but he recognized this woman even if she turned into ashes. Her name was Wen Xilin. At the same time, a memory that had been buried deep in the dust emerged. He looked at her crying with burning eyes, and smiled at the corner of his mouth.

There is a woman with good character and good health right in front of her, and what happened just now made Wen Jingrui know that Wen Xilin is in urgent need of some money. Isn't this just right?

Leading the quiet and well-behaved Shi Shi, he strolled up to Wen Xilin and said, "You just said that as long as anyone can save the person you are talking about, you will do anything you want?"

A voice reached her ears, and Wen Xilin raised her head in surprise and looked at the man who spoke.

He was tall, dressed in equestrian attire, and was leading a black horse. Because his back was turned to the sunset, she could not see his face clearly due to tears in her eyes.

who is he?Why are you talking to her?What's his purpose?

Wen Xilin rubbed her eyes and then saw the man's appearance clearly.His outline is very deep, and his strong character can be seen from his thick black sword eyebrows. His bright eyes do not contain much emotion. His facial features are deep, the bridge of his nose is high, and his thin lips are smiling slightly, but the smile does not reach his eyes.

This man exuded a dangerous aura, but his facial features made Wen Xilin feel familiar.

"Is ten million enough to help you?" Wen Jingrui asked slowly, playing with the riding crop in his hand.

"Too much..." Wen Xilin replied intuitively. Sheen's illness does not need to cost 10 million.

Wen Jingrui laughed when he heard this and became more and more satisfied with the woman in front of him."Wen Xilin, you really haven't changed at all." You are still so innocent and stupid.

When the man spoke to her just now, she was still confused, but now the man accurately called out her full name, which instantly brought her back to reality.

"Who are you?" Wen Xilin couldn't remember where she had seen this man. "Why are you willing to help me for no reason?" And she asked for 10 million.

Wen Jingrui let go of the reins of time, reached out to Wen Xilin, pulled her up from the ground, and asked her to stand up in front of him.

"My name is Wen Jingrui." After saying that, Wen Jingrui watched with satisfaction as her tear-filled eyes suddenly widened, turning from confusion to shock.

Good, she was definitely thinking of him.

"I'm so disappointed. You forgot about me. I recognized you right away." He smiled warmly and his expression was extremely gentle."Linlin, let's talk about a deal. I'll give you 10 million to save people, and you will marry me and help me have a child."

These words exploded in Wen Xilin's mind like a nuclear bomb. She opened her mouth slightly and stared blankly at the handsome man in front of her.

"Brother Jingrui..."

"I'm glad you remember me. How about your decision?" Wen Jingrui smiled, not thinking at all that she would refuse his request, no matter how unreasonable it was.

How could he be so sure that this woman wouldn't refuse?Oh, because he knew her very well. After all, Wen Xilin's mother was Wen Yuanhua's second wife in three marriages - he and the woman in front of him were once a family.

Chapter 2(1)

From the time Wen Jingrui could remember, his mother told him that he was the child of his parents' love.

"It's a pity that your grandfather doesn't like me." Not being accepted by the father of the beloved man, the mother's haggard face smiled bitterly."I'm five years older than your dad. He was only eighteen when we fell in love and was still a student. But I have no father or mother. I'm just an orphan who didn't even finish high school. For your dad's sake, I promised your grandpa to leave him. Your dad didn't know that I had you when I left. Jingrui, if your dad knows that you exist, he will definitely be very happy and love you very much."

The woman Wen Jingrui loves most in the world is his mother, and he is the only woman who truly believes in what his mother says. He will work hard to fulfill her expectations for him, and he will definitely do what his mother wants him to do.

When his mother learned that the cancer cells had spread throughout the body and that her time was running out, she asked him to return to the Wen family after his death to recognize his ancestors, take his father's surname Wen, and receive a good education.

Wen Jingrui carried out his mother's last wishes one by one. Not long after his mother passed away, he contacted his biological father with the help of social workers and met him. The situation at that time was completely different from what his mother believed.

"You are really my son," Wen Yuanhua exclaimed with a look of disbelief.

This question about Wen Jingrui's background immediately destroyed what his mother had told him for many years - they loved each other very much, and if it weren't for the opposition from his father's family, they would be a very happy family.

"What's your mother's name? Ah...ah, yes, I remembered it. She said you were my son? Is it true?" Wen Yuanhua scratched his head.

The biological father's undisguised surprise and subtle rejection did not escape Wen Jingrui's eyes.

"What are you talking about!" Along with Wen Yuanhua appeared a young and beautiful woman who definitely did not look thirty years old. She glared at him and said dissatisfiedly.

Unlike her mother, who worked long hours and was thin and with yellow hair, the woman in front of her had fair and smooth skin, no wrinkles at the corners of her eyes, black and shiny hair, and the clothes on her body were new and clean, with no signs of being washed or threaded.

Looking back at himself, he was wearing an old T-shirt that had been washed and faded, with a few small holes in it. His nails were not as clean as those of his father and the beautiful woman. There were still black oil stains on them that he could not wash off when he worked in a factory during the summer vacation. With just one glance, he knew that he and they were in different worlds.

"He looks exactly like dad. He is 100% a child of your Wen family. Wen Yuanhua, you can't even recognize your father's face when he was young? He is definitely your son!" The woman said while squeezing the flesh of Wen Yuanhua's waist."You are such a playboy, even your own children don't recognize you!"

"Don't pinch me, don't pinch me. Did I say no? Tsk, why aren't you jealous at all?" Wen Yuanhua immediately begged for mercy. Seeing that his wife didn't have any unpleasant reaction, he immediately became upset.

"Why are you jealous? Your child is my child." The woman glared at him, looking delicate and beautiful.

"Yaya, you are indeed the best woman." Wen Yuanhua hugged her tightly.

"Why else would you marry me?" The woman hugged him back, and the two of them flirted with each other, stroking vigorously, completely ignoring Wen Jingrui's existence.

Marry?father got married

Because of the sudden death of his mother, he was already in a low mood. Unexpectedly, when he met his father, there was no such thing as "Dad would be happy to have him" as his mother said.
